title: Your first job is receiving packages
scenario: A work-from-home employer gives you the title “Logistics Quality Coordinator.” Packages arrive at your apartment; your job is to inspect them, remove old labels and reship them to new addresses.

answers.A: Continue for one pay cycle because legitimate remote logistics jobs can involve repackaging.
answers.B: Stop and verify the employer; do not reship goods, and seek advice/report the job if items have already arrived.
answers.C: Keep the packages unopened while you contact the carrier or appropriate authority for guidance.

explanation: Reshipping schemes can involve goods bought with stolen payment information, leaving you in the middle of the fraud.
proTip: A job that turns your home into a forwarding hub deserves immediate scrutiny.
